units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 10:24">Targ. Prov. X, 24</cite> (h. text <cite ref="T00864"><he>רַע</he></cite>!); a. fr. [<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 3:1">Targ. Hos. III, 1</cite> <he>בחבריּה</he>, v. <cite ref="H01222"><he>חַמְרָא</he> I</cite>.]—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 28b:5">B. Bath. 28ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>חַבְרָךְ ח׳ אית ליה וכ׳</he> thy friend has a friend, and thy friend’s friend has a friend (you cannot claim ignorance).
<cite ref="Shabbat 31a:6">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>דעלך סני לחברך וכ׳</he> do not unto thy neighbor what would be hateful to thee; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>חַבְרִין</he>, <he>חַבְרֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Beitzah 25a:3">Bets. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>חַבְרִין</he> our fellow-student (Rab Ḥisda); <cite ref="H00880"><he>בר ח׳</he></cite> the son of &c. (Rab Huna).—Y. Taan.
